rows.role_title: نائب رئيس مجلس الشورى — Vice Chairman of the Shura Council (presiding)
rows.text: Release dated January 27, 2002: 'today's regular session of the Consultative Council ... presided over by Deputy Chairman Bakri Shata'; the Secretary-General read an obituary of 'the late Shaikh Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Jubair, the Council's deceased chairman'.
